name: Light Action SS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 274 g for the RD-L523-SS assembly. The catalogue capacity reference uses Any Shimano fork ends for the short cage. SI-P-4 additionally requires the B-tension screw fully tightened and notes that fork/frame dimensions affect capacity.
